main_issue: Who covers Agent D's unfinished pitch section for Thursday given her bereavement, and whether B and C can take on the extra work

A-B.evidence: A insists everyone make the hours (T5, T10, T12); B repeatedly refuses (T6, T9, T11, T17); A concedes 'Fine. I'll do whatever's left... B, keep doing your other work' (T18).

A-C.evidence: A orders C to take the handover (T16, T21) and C refuses (T20, T22, T24); finally D suggests A do it and A agrees (T26), relieving C.

A-D.evidence: A tells D to go and D offers a handover (T3, T15, T16); D proposes walking A through the analysis and A agrees 'Yes. Fine.' (T25-26).

B-C.evidence: Both independently refuse A's demands for extra work (B T4-T17; C T7, T20-T24); they never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B never addresses D, and D never addresses B; D's final plan (T25) leaves B out of the extra work, in line with B's position.

C-D.evidence: D first pushes the handover to C (T15, T23); C objects (T24); D concedes 'You're right, Agent C' and redirects to A (T25).
